goal: Obtain a WATER or GRASS type Pokemon

subgoals.goal_text: Travel from Route 24 back to Cerulean City.
Visit the Pokemon Center in Cerulean City to heal the party.
Go to the Cerulean Mart and buy more Poke Balls to ensure enough for catching.
Return to Route 24 to find a Water type Pokemon in the water.
Catch a Water or Grass type Pokemon in the wild.
